first_safe_session_plan: Run harness instructions and inspect harness doctor --json.
Run harness checks focused for the scoped test target.
Run harness boot --json and require harness readiness --json before interaction.
Make the scoped change through RPIV and capture concrete friction through the configured hooks.
Run harness checks full --json, then harness stop --json and retain durable AC evidence.

evidence_log.claim: Checks, boot, readiness, stop, evidence, RPIV seams, and the exact engineering-harness allowlist (eng-harness-flow, eng-harness-0-harnessability-assessment, grill-agent-done) are explicitly governed.
Independent verification passed full validation, lifecycle, ownership safety, documentation, and cleanup.
Boot validates PID start time, command, and process group before signalling and refuses unknown listeners.
Harness validation delegates without duplicating root recipe bodies.
Cold-agent and operator discovery is consolidated and distinguishes ambient CLI ownership.
